ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, $O$ is a point on the line $CE$. With $O$ as the vertex, we make $ \angle AOB=90^\circ$, and $OA$, $OB$ are on opposite sides of the line $CE$, $ \angle AOC=50^\circ$, and $OB$ bisects $ \angle COD$. Find the degree measure of $ \angle DOE$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} 

Given that, $\angle BOC = \angle AOB - \angle AOC = 90^\circ - 50^\circ = 40^\circ$,\\
since OB bisects $\angle COD$,\\
it follows that $\angle COD = 2\angle BOC = 80^\circ$,\\
thus, $\angle DOE = 180^\circ - \angle COD = \boxed{100^\circ}$.
